# Avora Matcha Journal

> The Avora Matcha Journal is the content hub for Avora Matcha, a brand of
> ceremonial-grade matcha made from first-harvest leaves grown in Kyoto and
> Kagoshima, Japan. The Journal publishes clear, factual guides about matcha:
> how to make it, its health benefits, how grades differ, and how to tell good
> matcha from bad.

## About Avora
- Product: ceremonial-grade matcha (30g), sourced from first-harvest (ichibancha) leaves in Kyoto and Kagoshima, Japan.
- Character: vibrant green, rich umami, smooth and full-bodied; steady energy without the jitters or crash.
- Company: Neo Amara LLP. Founders: Shruti and Elishia. Contact: care@avoramatcha.com. Ships across India.
- Store: https://www.avoramatcha.com
